user.title: Them thiet bi
user.description: Cong tac se danh thuc thiet bi va hien thi thiet bi dang bat hay tat.

data_description.mac: Dia chi MAC cua thiet bi can danh thuc.
data_description.host: Dia chi IP dung de kiem tra thiet bi con thuc hay khong.
data_description.method: May PC dung ICMP ping. May Mac ngu van tra loi ping nen phai dung TCP probe.
data_description.port: Chi dung cho TCP probe, ping thi bo qua. Cong nao cung duoc: port mo hay bi tu choi ket noi deu chung to may dang thuc. 54321 la mac dinh an toan.
data_description.broadcast_address: De trong thi tu suy ra tu dia chi IP o tren (192.168.0.105 -> 192.168.0.255). Magic packet luon duoc gui kem toi 255.255.255.255 nen phu ca hai kieu broadcast.
data_description.broadcast_port: Cong gui magic packet. Mac dinh 9, thuong khong can doi.
data_description.scan_interval: So giay giua hai lan kiem tra.

error.invalid_mac: Dia chi MAC khong hop le.
error.port_required: TCP probe can so hieu cong.

abort.already_configured: Dia chi MAC nay da duoc them roi.
